audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate answers were on the page. The full layer said Skill, Galio, Galio, Skill, Skill, Veigar, Veigar; the content layer said Galio on all seven; and packet.levelChart said Galio on all seven while its own defect list called that impossible against a 46.31% win rate.
audit.why: The kit settles it. Veigar has no dash and Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1, so Galio genuinely owns levels 1 through 6 — he can walk up on the Baleful Strike cast and there is no answer. But Phenomenal Evil grants permanent ability power with no cap, so the first-item and two-item rows belong to Veigar. Galio winning all seven stages cannot coexist with 46.31%.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Veigar, Veigar in both layers. Full-layer sides moved on rows 0, 3 and 4; content win[5] and win[6] moved to Veigar to match the full layer, which already read Veigar there. Ratings and whys rewritten on every row that moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Veigar's first item and late game as Galio spikes ('your MR makes AP trades a subscription you sell', 'your dive-and-disrupt kit still outpaces his immobile burst mage profile'). It never states that his ability power is uncapped.
audit.why: Passive: 'Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.' That is the whole reason the matchup inverts after first item, and it was absent.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why, phases[6].why, whys[5], whys[6], `late`, spikes[2], spikes[3], ahead and breakdown.carry now all key off the permanent stacking.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primordial Burst was described as a 'percent-HP execute' in spikes[3] and `late`, and as a 'true-damage execute' in spikes[2]. It is neither.
audit.why: enemyKit R: 'dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health'. Magic damage, scaling on missing health, no true damage and no execute threshold. Calling it true damage tells a Galio his MR is worthless when it is the single stat that reduces it.
audit.corrected: All three now say magic damage that grows with your missing health.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d called Event Horizon a 'fifteen-second' invitation.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20/18.5/17/15.5/14, Baleful Strike 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, Primordial Burst 120/90/60 at 650 range, and Dark Matter's cooldown shrinks with Phenomenal Evil stacks.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in; the invitation corrected to twenty seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The title promised one thing and the body explained another.
audit.corrected: Both replaced with bodies grounded in Event Horizon's 20s window and the cage-edge stun.
